martini.definition: A cocktail made of gin (or vodka) with dry vermouth.

old-fashioned.definition: The name of a traditional alcoholic mixed drink category, commonly associated with spirits, sweetener, and bitters.
old-fashioned.exampleUsage: The guest asks whether an alcohol-free alternative to the Old Fashioned is available.
old-fashioned.arabicTranslation: أولد فاشند؛ اسم مشروب كحولي كلاسيكي

manhattan.definition: A cocktail made with whiskey and sweet vermouth with a dash of bitters.

negroni.definition: The name of a classic alcoholic mixed drink traditionally associated with gin, bitter aperitif, and sweet vermouth.
negroni.exampleUsage: The menu lists a Negroni separately from the other named categories.

daiquiri.definition: A cocktail made with rum and lime or lemon juice.

margarita.definition: A named mixed-drink category traditionally associated with tequila, orange liqueur, and lime.

mojito.definition: The name of a classic alcoholic mixed drink traditionally associated with rum, lime, mint, sugar, and soda water.
mojito.exampleUsage: The guest asks which ingredients the venue uses in its Mojito.

whiskey-sour.definition: A cocktail made by combining whiskey with sour ingredients, usually lemon juice and sweetener.
whiskey-sour.exampleUsage: The trainee checks the ingredient record for the Whiskey Sour.

sidecar.definition: A cocktail made of orange liqueur with lemon juice and brandy.

sazerac.definition: A cocktail traditionally made with cognac or rye whiskey, sugar, bitters, and an absinthe rinse.

cosmopolitan.definition: A cocktail made with vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry juice, and lime juice.

pi-a-colada.definition: The name of a sweet alcoholic mixed drink traditionally associated with rum, coconut, and pineapple.
pi-a-colada.exampleUsage: The menu description distinguishes the Piña Colada from the other named drinks.

long-island-iced-tea.definition: The name of a strong alcoholic mixed drink that typically contains several spirits despite its tea-like name.
long-island-iced-tea.exampleUsage: The guest checks the alcohol content before interpreting the name Long Island Iced Tea.
long-island-iced-tea.arabicTranslation: لونغ آيلاند آيسد تي؛ اسم مشروب كحولي

moscow-mule.definition: The name of a classic alcoholic mixed drink traditionally associated with vodka, ginger beer, and lime.
moscow-mule.exampleUsage: The menu lists Moscow Mule as a named mixed-drink category.

gimlet.definition: A cocktail made of gin or vodka and lime juice.

tom-collins.definition: A named mixed-drink category traditionally associated with gin, lemon, sweetener, and soda water.

paloma.definition: A cocktail made with tequila, grapefruit soda, and lime.
paloma.exampleUsage: The guest asks what the venue means by Paloma.

aperol-spritz.definition: The name of an alcoholic aperitif-style mixed drink traditionally associated with Aperol and sparkling wine.
aperol-spritz.exampleUsage: The menu distinguishes Aperol Spritz from an alcohol-free spritz.

espresso-martini.definition: The name of an alcoholic mixed drink traditionally associated with coffee or espresso and spirits.
espresso-martini.exampleUsage: The guest asks about the ingredients in the Espresso Martini.

dark-and-stormy.definition: The name of an alcoholic mixed drink traditionally associated with dark rum and ginger beer.
dark-and-stormy.exampleUsage: The trainee records Dark and Stormy as a menu name rather than a weather description.
dark-and-stormy.arabicTranslation: دارك آند ستورمي؛ اسم مشروب كحولي

shaken.definition: Mixed by shaking the ingredients, usually with ice.

stirred.definition: Mixed by moving a spoon or other tool around in a liquid.

muddled.definition: Crushed gently to release flavor, especially fruit or herbs in a drink.

layered.definition: With one layer on top of another.

blended.definition: Mixed using a blender in this beverage-preparation context.

built.definition: Prepared by adding the ingredients directly to the serving glass.

strained.definition: Poured through a strainer to remove ice or solid pieces.

double-strained.definition: A beverage-service term meaning liquid has been passed through two strainers to remove more solid particles.
double-strained.exampleUsage: The worksheet says the sample was double strained through two strainers.

flamed.definition: In beverage or food presentation, describing an item briefly ignited by trained professionals for a visual or aromatic effect.
flamed.exampleUsage: The safety lesson notes that flamed presentation involves fire and is for trained professionals only.

infused.definition: Flavored by leaving an ingredient in a liquid.

on-the-rocks.definition: A beverage-service expression meaning served over pieces of ice.
on-the-rocks.exampleUsage: The request says on the rocks, meaning served over ice.

neat.definition: Served without ice, mixers, or other added liquid.

straight-up.definition: A beverage-service expression generally meaning served chilled and without ice remaining in the final glass.
straight-up.exampleUsage: The server asks the guest to clarify what straight up means in the request.

dirty.definition: Describing a martini made with olive brine.

dry.definition: In a martini description, commonly indicating a smaller proportion of vermouth.

wet.definition: Describing a martini with a larger proportion of vermouth.

virgin.definition: Describing a version of a drink made without alcohol.
virgin.exampleUsage: The guest requests a virgin version and asks the server to confirm its ingredients.

top-shelf.definition: A bar-industry expression for higher-priced or premium-branded alcoholic products.
top-shelf.exampleUsage: The guest asks which products the venue classifies as top shelf.

well-drink.definition: A bar-industry term for a mixed alcoholic drink made with the venue's standard lower-priced house spirit.
well-drink.exampleUsage: The price list distinguishes a well drink from the premium range.
well-drink.arabicTranslation: مشروب كحولي من الفئة الأساسية في البار

house-special.definition: A drink featured as the bar's own specialty.
